_comment: The physical tokens, for the Reference's Rules tab (Tokens on the table, OTTO 2026-10-01): every piece in the box, grouped by where it sits, so a player holding one can find it. Reference only: nothing in play reads this. A token the engine also tracks names its StatusDef in `status` (app/src/types.ts STATUSES) and takes its name, text and pictures from there, so each rule is written once. `faces` are files in assets/tokens/print, without the extension. A token with no `faces` and no status picture is drawn as a dashed outline of its `shape`, over its `caption` (No picture yet, unless it says otherwise). Every token carries a `ref`, so every card ends on its source and the cards of a row line up. `see` names Mechanics entries (mechanics.json ids). The text states the rule alone and never mentions the apps.
_source: Rulebook 2.4.2, 2.5.1 to 2.5.5, 3.7.4, 4.1, 4.4.3, 4.7, 4.9, 4.16, 6.3; FAQ M27. Pictures: the publisher's token art, and for the Smoke Screen card and the Victory Point and Numeric Identifier tokens the rulebook's own illustrations (book p.20 and p.76), cut at their printed size. The Task Item Tokens are an outline until real token pictures are found (OTTO, 2026-10-01: the rulebook's group picture is not a token image).

families.name: On the cards: Round Tokens
families.text: A Round Token tracks something a card can run out of. Coloured face up, it is available. Black face up, it is consumed.
families.note: Round Token. It sits on the Part Card or Unit Card.

families.name: On the cards: Triangle Tokens
families.text: A Triangle Token marks the condition of a Part and sits on that Part's card. Both faces are the same.
families.note: Triangle Token. It sits on the Part Card.

families.name: Beside the model: Square Tokens
families.text: A Square Token affects the unit that bears it, and a unit may bear any number. A yellow one turns to its red face at the end of the round. A red one comes off at the end of the round.
families.note: Square Token. It sits beside the model.

families.name: Beside the model: Hexagon Tokens
families.text: A Hexagon Token changes how other units treat its bearer. A unit bears only one, so a new one replaces the old. A green one stays until something removes it.
families.note: Hexagon Token. It sits beside the model.

families.name: On the Mech's base: Stance Tokens
families.text: One of the four sits on the base of the Mech's model and shows its Stance.
families.note: Rectangular. It sits on the base of the Mech's model.

families.name: On and beside the board
families.text: Pieces that belong to the game and not to one unit.

families.name: States, with no token
families.text: A State is something a unit is in. No piece marks it.
families.note: Not a token. It is a State the unit is in.

tokens.name: Ammunition
tokens.text: An Action with an Ammo icon can be performed a limited number of times. At Deployment its card takes one token for each mark on the icon, coloured face up. Performing the Action turns one face down, and with none left face up the Action cannot be performed.
tokens.note: Round Token. It sits on the Part Card.

tokens.name: Charge
tokens.text: Placed black face up at Deployment, which means not yet Charged. The Charge Action turns it coloured face up. An Action with a Charged effect may then consume it, turning it back over, to apply that effect.
tokens.note: Round Token. It sits on the Part Card.

tokens.name: Interception
tokens.text: A Part with Intercept X takes X of these at Deployment, coloured face up. Each Interception attempt turns one face down, and a spent one is not restored.
tokens.note: Round Token. It sits on the Part Card.

tokens.name: Damaged
tokens.text: A Part or unit with a Structure Value takes one the first time it is Penetrated. While it bears one it rolls White dice equal to its Structure Value in place of its Armor Value, and the next Penetration Destroys it.

tokens.name: Stance
tokens.text: A Mech chooses its Stance when it is deployed, and again each time it gets an Action Opportunity, before it Maneuvers. The token on its base shows which of the four it is in.

tokens.name: First Player Token
tokens.text: Sits beside the board where both players can see it, with the First Player's colour face up. It is turned over at the end of every round, so the other player goes first in the next.

tokens.name: Landing Point Token
tokens.text: Marks the Landing Point of a Projectile that has no model of its own: the Small Grid its controller chose for it. Most are Projectiles with an Immediate Action, which resolve where the token sits.

tokens.name: Smoke Screen
tokens.text: Placed when a Projectile such as a Smoke Grenade detonates, and it fills the Grid it is placed in. The side facing up shows which player placed it.
tokens.note: A square card, black on one side and white on the other.

tokens.name: Numeric Identifier
tokens.text: Numbered, black on one side and white on the other. One sits by the model and its match on the card, to tell identical units apart.

tokens.name: Task Item Tokens
tokens.text: Five-sided tokens for what a Task puts on the table: a Black Box, a Terminal, a Commander. One that is picked up rides on the card of the unit carrying it. The larger Control Zones token sits in a Tactical Zone and shows which side controls it.

tokens.name: Victory Point
tokens.text: Taken as Victory Points are scored from Tasks, one for each point.
